summary: Accomplished Senior Network Engineer with 15+ years of progressive experience designing, implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting enterprise-grade networking infrastructure. Proven expertise in managing complex network environments, optimizing performance, and ensuring high availability across diverse platforms including Cisco, MikroTik, Ubiquiti, and Fortinet. Strong background in fiber optic installations, VPN configurations, firewall management, and traffic analysis.

highlights: Designed and deployed enterprise-grade networks for 20+ clients including ISPs and educational institutions
Implemented secure VPN solutions and firewall configurations reducing security incidents by 100%
Conducted network audits and performance optimization achieving 99.9% uptime
Provided 24/7 technical support and emergency response for critical infrastructure
Managed network infrastructure for multiple concurrent enterprise projects
Implemented advanced routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) for complex topologies
Configured and maintained enterprise firewalls and security systems
Trained technical teams on best practices and new technologies
Installed and configured routers, switches, and wireless access points for 100+ sites
Performed fiber optic cable installations and terminations across enterprise environments
Monitored network performance and resolved connectivity issues with <1hr MTTR
Maintained detailed documentation of network configurations and change management

technical_expertise.networking: TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing & Switching, QoS, Network Security
technical_expertise.platforms: Cisco IOS, MikroTik RouterOS, Ubiquiti UniFi, Fortinet FortiGate
technical_expertise.infrastructure: Fiber Optic, Structured Cabling, Wireless Networks
technical_expertise.security: Firewalls, VPN (IPSec, SSL), Access Control, Intrusion Detection
